_comment: One issue owning two files, used by the --worker-method cases (Issue #128 / ADR §12 段4). ONE issue on purpose: the two-point measurement runs this same plan twice — once with --worker-method and once without — and the whole claim is that the two reports differ only in what the flag adds. A second issue would put a second wave between the two runs without adding anything the measurement needs.

issues.title: feat: add the retry budget
issues.body:
Add the retry budget across `src/retry/budget.ts` and `src/retry/index.ts`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `src/retry/budget.ts` refuses a negative budget
- [ ] `src/retry/index.ts` exports the budget
